所选手柄未连接，无法录入体感输入。: The selected controller is disconnected. Connect it to record a gyro input.
开启和暂停不能使用同一个输入，请重新录入。: Activation and pause need different inputs. Try recording again.
一次只录入一个体感输入，请重试。: Record one gyro input at a time. Try again.
检测到多个输入，请全部松开。: Multiple inputs detected. Release all controls.
请先松开当前输入并让摇杆回中。: Release the controls and let the sticks return to center first.
请按下或接触要录入的手柄输入。: Press a controller input or touch the touchpad.
录入期间暂停游戏输出，Esc 可取消。: Game output pauses during recording. Press Esc to cancel.
触摸板按下与手指接触可以分别绑定。连接并选择手柄后，也可以直接监听录入。: Touchpad clicks and finger contact can be bound separately. Connect and select a controller to record directly.
